title: Daily Build
subtitle: Building new things daily using AI tools
description: Building new things daily using AI tools
html:
If you’re also a subscriber to the old Traction Newsletter, I’m sorry you’re seeing this message twice! Please don’t hurt me!

I made Daily Build.

It’s a newsletter where I build new projects daily using the latest AI tools…

Why are you doing this?

These new tools are immensely powerful, and AI will be a fundamental layer to technology going forward.

…And it seems like so many people just don’t know where to begin!

We don’t know what we don’t know. You know?

I want to bridge the gap for people.

So I’m helping folks make apps, icons, widgets, spreadsheets, products and much more.

If that sounds interesting, you can follow along with me here!

You might even learn a thing or two… really, I just want to inspire people to be more creative—and these tools help give us superpowers.

Some things I’ve built in under 20 mins (for real):

  • MacOS note-taking app

  • Weather app using an API

  • Fancy calculator

I have a lot of fun projects planned that you won’t want to miss…

Please take a minute to look and I hope you sign up!

Thank you all - I love and appreciate you. 🙏

Sign up for Daily Build

Hold on -

Know someone who’d dig this?

Please please please forward them this email :)

https://dailybuild.co
